HOW TO USE THESE BANNERS

Click any text to retype it in place. The dashed boxes mark where your logo goes. The photos are ready to use as they are, or select one to swap in your own. Each banner is a 1:2 roll-up (for example 33 x 66 in or 30 x 60 in). Export PNG or PDF from the toolbar when you are ready to send it to your printer.
